record.question: Consider the following statements (i) The National Human Rights Commission came into force on 12th October 1993 through a Government notification under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993. (ii) The National Human Rights Commission investigate complaints of human rights violation or negligence by public servants. (iii) The National Human Rights Commission promote human rights literacy and awareness. (iv) The National Human Rights Commission has judicial power to ensure compliance. Which of the above statements are correct?
